text: Bring docs/design/requirements-map.md and docs/design/strategy-view.md up to date. Add rows for the BRIEF.md addenda added since the map was written (2026-10-13: Root causes; Introspection on every correction; Decision sets, and knowing when a decision is not working; 2026-10-14: Common sense over rigid rules), and re-assess the status of every row against what has landed since (native PR landing with squash resync and merge via REST, the root-cause and changelog defaults, compact reader defaults, the pipe-deadlock fix, decision sets with the typed decision view, host-error records and the D87 backtest, introspection with retry-from-record, defaults proposals, the Jev client in shadow and score-jev, the non-Rust intent check). Each status change cites the commit or file that justifies it. Recount the coverage table exactly. Rewrite 'What to do next' as an ordered list toward the brief, naming what blocks each step.
